description: GreEn-ER is a public dataset of raw electricity consumption from the building-management system of the GreEn-ER tertiary teaching and research building in Grenoble, France. The authors report about 330 electricity meters; the repository describes more than 300. Each meter has a CSV time series of interval energy in kWh at 10-minute resolution for 2017 and 2018. The deposit also includes whole-building electricity files, outdoor-temperature series for those years, system-design CSVs, and four Jupyter notebooks with meter tables, building drawings, and exploratory analysis. The university research groups published it for data-driven studies of tertiary-building demand. Version 1 is available from Mendeley Data, free under CC BY 4.0, with no registration stated. It covers one building and two historical years. Meter labels and sector drawings are available, but coordinates are not stated; the data are raw and may need cleaning. It can support building-load forecasting, calibration, and demand-management or capacity-planning models. No directly linked record was found in this catalogue.
